notes: MTOP train split, de-DE slice, one row per utterance (template == the utterance verbatim). Same tasksource/mtop source and lang_field filter as the eval entry; intent_id uses the same domain:intent normalization as the eval labels so template-paradigm fighters train against the identical label space they are scored on. tasksource/mtop ships a legacy Python loading script under its default 'mtop' config name, which the current `datasets` library refuses to execute ('Dataset scripts are no longer supported') — registered against HF's auto-generated parquet conversion instead (revision='refs/convert/parquet', builder config 'default'), the same escape hatch used elsewhere in this registry for legacy-script sources.
